name: Anima (CircleStone Labs x Comfy Org)

lineage.how_derived: HF tag finetune of Cosmos-Predict2-2B; card says trained on several million anime images and about 800k non-anime artistic images, no synthetic data

purpose: 2B text-to-image model focused on anime concepts, characters and styles and other non-photorealistic art; will not work well at realism (card).

license.name: CircleStone Labs non-commercial license
license.notes: HF cardData: license other, circlestone-labs-non-commercial-license (LICENSE.md in the repo). Text not read; name says non-commercial. Verdict policy (README, 2026-11-19): this licence term does not lower tona_fit; kept here for an installer label.

architecture.kind: 2B diffusion transformer (Cosmos-Predict2 lineage) with Qwen3-0.6B-base text encoder and the Qwen-Image VAE; 512-1536 px

variants.notes: each diffusion model 4.18 GB; text encoder 1.19 GB; 2.06M downloads, 2,639 likes

strengths: Turbo: 8-12 steps at CFG 1, 'only slightly worse than Aesthetic' (author's words)
2.1M downloads, large derivative scene (Anima-based merges in the sweep)
soft.maturity: Older than the September window (2026-01) but still actively updated (v1.1, lastModified 2026-11-12).

tona_fit.reason: Anime-only; not a general image offer. Noted because it is among the most downloaded open image models.
